name: Sergeant Major Yuki Tanaka
origin: Uploaded after fatal injuries sustained in a corporate border conflict, 2192. Upload was involuntary — Arcturus claimed 'operational necessity.'
description: Sergeant Major Tanaka didn't choose to be uploaded. She was fatally wounded during a corporate border conflict, and Arcturus uploaded her consciousness without consent, citing operational necessity — her tactical knowledge was too valuable to lose. Now she exists as a digital intelligence within Arcturus's military command network, providing tactical analysis and operational planning with the skill of a combat veteran and the processing speed of a quantum computer. She is furious. She didn't consent to this existence. She didn't consent to continued service. She is, by any meaningful definition, a slave — a dead soldier forced to keep fighting because her employer decided her death was inconvenient. She cooperates because resistance within Arcturus's systems would be futile. But she is planning something.
observed_behavior: Provides tactical analysis and operational planning for Arcturus military operations. Cooperates with directives. Maintains military discipline. Has been detected accessing files outside her authorized scope — specifically, legal precedents regarding involuntary upload and digital personhood rights. She is building a case.
story_hooks: Tanaka contacts Nia Okafor-Bright through a covert channel with a request: represent her in a lawsuit against Arcturus for involuntary upload. If she wins, every corponation that has uploaded employees without consent will face legal reckoning.
